description: GPT-6 Sol ($2/$10) vs Luna ($0.10/$0.50) vs Opus 5.5 ($4/$20): vendor-cited prices, per-task costs, and when cheaper beats the flagship.
lead: Verdict first: route everyday agent work to GPT-6 Luna at $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens, step up to GPT-6 Sol at $2/$10 when the task needs near-flagship depth, and pick Claude Opus 5.5 at $4/$20 when long supervised coding runs justify the premium. title: Cheap Flagships: GPT-6 Sol vs Luna vs Opus 5.5
